answer: A Dedicated device bound by DNS record proof with a ninety-day rotation cooldown turns a private channel into public evidence: the dedicated device answers a fresh challenge, the DNS record proof is recorded, and a ninety-day rotation cooldown keeps one channel from spawning many identities, so anyone can check that the identity is backed by a real, reachable channel. The system trusts a comet only after its channel answers the challenge. When the plume settles over the vertex, the binding holds because every channel answered its own challenge.
